# Native extension-version catalog declarations

The whole native CF/XML owner belongs to BUH ВерсииРасширений, class56/61 with measured owner2/10 and own2/8 headers. Both own rows use wrapper5/6 with exact tails0,0,1,1. Expected types were independently read from Catalog.xml: unbounded Variable String and DateTime, represented as Pattern[S] and Pattern[D]. Existing membership/standard fields/empty sections were already known before this patch; only missing qualified declarations are restored.

Causal synthetic header-tag controls are recorded separately and never substituted for native input. No role policy or privilege behavior is changed. Principal-native-role-comparison retains three base XML roles including ПолныеПрава; the fourth extension-named role has no base XML in this extraction and its rights are not inferred. Owner Read is independently granted by ПолныеПрава default.
